title: 대수기하학 원론 (EGA) — 한국어 누적판 / Éléments de géométrie algébrique — Korean Cumulative Edition
description:
읽기 / Read first: open 00_EGA_ko_CUMULATIVE_READER.pdf. This exact cumulative release covers EGA I front matter and introduction, all of EGA 0_I, the Chapter I programme and §§1–9, and §10 through Proposition 10.5.6. It does not claim that the full EGA corpus is complete.

This Korean edition remains in one language lineage. It is a translation of and part of the stable global/source EGA object at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20414353. Editable TeX, exact source identities, decisions, corrections, build evidence, extraction checks, visual QA and SHA-256 manifests are included.
